title: In-Context Learning for System Identification: Probabilistic Formulation, Long-Sequence Handling, and Benchmark Validation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13411v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Traditional system identification typically involves two steps: initially, training data is processed to estimate a model of the system of interest; then, the model is used to predict outputs for new input queries. In contrast, recent in-context learning approaches learn a meta model that maps directly from training data and query inputs to outputs in a zero-shot fashion, bypassing explicit model estimation. This approach leverages a meta model trained offline, on large sets of synthetically generated data, to emulate the behavior of a system identification algorithm. In this work, we advance this meta-learning framework for system identification in three directions. First, we develop a unified probabilistic meta-identification architecture that combines a Transformer-based encoder-decoder with tailored mechanisms for handling long training sequences, enabling calibrated predictions over long horizons. translated_title: 面向系统辨识的上下文学习：概率化建模、长序列处理与基准验证
translated_abstract: 传统的系统辨识通常包含两个步骤：首先，对训练数据进行处理以估计目标系统的模型；然后，利用该模型对新输入查询进行输出预测。相比之下，近期的上下文学习方法学习一个元模型，以零样本方式直接从训练数据和查询输入映射到输出，从而绕过显式的模型估计。该方法利用在大量合成生成数据上离线训练的元模型，来模拟系统辨识算法的行为。在本工作中，我们从三个方向推进了这一面向系统辨识的元学习框架。首先，我们开发了一个统一的概率化元辨识架构，该架构将基于Transformer的编码器-解码器与专为处理长训练序列设计的机制相结合，实现了长时域上的校准预测。其次，我们展示了如何利用预训练的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种统一的概率化上下文学习元辨识架构，将基于Transformer的编码器-解码器与长序列处理机制相结合，实现长时域校准预测，并通过基准测试验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This work advances meta-learning for system identification by developing a unified probabilistic in-context learning architecture that combines a Transformer encoder-decoder with tailored long-sequence handling mechanisms, enabling calibrated long-horizon predictions validated through benchmarks.
